subject: Incubation package — request for temporary credits / billing carve-out
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@seedforge.vc>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Incubation package question: flexibility on credits & billing

Hi Soojin,

Quick question from SeedForge — we have a portfolio company (LoopScale) starting your incubation package next week and the cohort sponsor would like to know if there's any flexibility on two items:

- Can the promotional credits issued at onboarding be reallocated across teams within the cohort for the first 6 months? Some of our founders split usage across multiple product teams.
- If they don’t use the credits within the standard 90-day window, is there an ability to extend or issue a one-time top-up for exceptional cases (e.g., hardware delays)?

We also have a time-sensitive procurement cycle: if we can confirm an approach by Friday (25 Aug) we can include the adjusted credit terms in the purchase order to speed approval.

Attaching the cohort overview for context.

Thanks — Elena

--
Elena Morris
Director, Portfolio Programs
SeedForge Ventures
[Attachment: SeedForge_Deck.pdf (pdf)]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@seedforge.vc>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Incubation package question: flexibility on credits & billing

Hi Elena — great to hear from you (and congrats to LoopScale). Short answer: we can make a limited, time-bound exception but we prefer to document it as a scoped carve-out so expectations are clear.

Quick notes:
- Standard policy: onboarding promotional credits expire 90 days after issuance and are tied to the account that received them.
- Exception approach we can offer: cohort-level reallocation for up to 6 months (admin-managed), or a one-time bridge/top-up credit issued to the account sponsor with explicit usage windows.

I’ve sketched a draft carve-out (attached) that shows two paths: 1) cohort pool (credits pooled and distributed by SeedForge), or 2) sponsor-managed top-up (Redwood issues a supplemental credit balance to a sponsor-designated account). The draft also shows token equivalence and a suggested amortized discount (more below).

If you’re open, can we do a short call tomorrow to finalize which path works for procurement? I can loop in Rishi to confirm pricing mechanics.

Attachment: Incubation-terms-draft-v1.docx

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: suggested pricing carve-out for SeedForge

Soojin — a couple of product/pricing notes to consider before we firm this up with Elena:

- For cohort pooling: propose we allow up to 200k token-equivalent credits pooled across the cohort for 6 months. No cash refund, but unspent credits expire at the end of the window.
- For sponsor top-up: we can offer a one-time top-up at a promotional rate (example: retail equivalent $3,000, promo price $1,800) — this is essentially a 40% off top-up to help engineers bridge delays.
- Approval: anything > $2,000 promo liability needs sign-off from Ben (rev ops/sales) and finance.

I’ll draft the promo line items to make it easy for procurement to include in PO. We should also record the exemption in the agreement (small addendum).

Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Pricing Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@seedforge.vc>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Incubation package — proposed carve-out for SeedForge cohort

Elena — thanks for the quick turn. Based on our internal discussion we can offer the following two straightforward options for LoopScale/cohort: 

Option A — Cohort pool (recommended if you want one balance across teams):
- Up to 200k token-equivalent credits pooled across the cohort, valid for 6 months from issue date.
- Unused credits expire at window end.
- No additional paperwork beyond a one-line addendum to the onboarding SOW.

Option B — Sponsor top-up (recommended for sponsor-managed usage):
- One-time top-up credit issued to the sponsor-designated account. Example: 50k token-equivalent top-up at a promo price of $1,800 (retail $3,000).
- Top-up valid for 90 days from issuance.
- Requires PO line item referencing deal id SF-2028-042 and the addendum.

Next steps: if either looks good we can push a short addendum and a PO-friendly pricing line. If you confirm Option B, I can route for Ben's approval so finance can sign off on the promo liability.

Proposed meeting times: Thu 23 Aug 10:00–10:30 PT or Fri 24 Aug 09:00–09:30 PT. Which works?

Best,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Thanks — Option B (sponsor top-up) looks clean for our procurement flow. We’ll request the PO line item for the 50k top-up at $1,800. I can do Fri 24 Aug 09:00 PT.

Can you confirm: who will own the addendum signature? We typically need it signed by the vendor (Redwood) and the sponsor (SeedForge) noted in the PO. Also please send the precise PO language so my legal/finance team can include it.

—Elena

Subject: Re: Incubation package — next steps and PO language

Perfect — thanks Elena. Per procurement guidance below is the PO-friendly line and signoff path. I’ve looped in Ben for formal promo approval and to confirm contract execution steps.

PO line item (copy/paste):
- Vendor: Redwood Inference
- Description: Sponsor top-up — 50,000 token-equivalent promotional credit for SeedForge cohort (LoopScale) — promo price $1,800. Valid 90 days from issuance. Reference: deal_id SF-2028-042.
- Notes: Invoice Redwood and reference Addendum #1 (Incubation Sponsor Top-up Addendum). Credits are non-refundable and expire at end of validity window.

Signoff path: Redwood signs Addendum #1 (vendor), SeedForge signs on PO as sponsor. We’ll provision top-up after PO is received and payment terms cleared.

Next: Ben — can you confirm promo approval (<= $1,800) and if finance needs any additional language? If good, I’ll prepare the addendum and the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Soojin
